svg.title: One operator. One cluster.
svg.desc: Browsers reach Cloudflare, then a k3s cluster running Traefik, Laravel, Node and workers. GitHub Actions and Argo CD deliver releases; AWS SSM and External Secrets supply configuration. MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Meilisearch and R2 hold state. Grafana receives observability data. Animated paths illustrate direction, not live traffic.
